book.name: 1 Timoti
book.title: Nzryr-krbz Pol Kx Ayrnrngr Mz Timoti

content: Kxnzawzng Badr Kxetu Rdrng
Kxnzawzng amrlx kcng tzrlxngiting na-amatq-zvzlr kxetu rdrng, murde ma tzpibqti drtq Gct rgu x nzalvztr-krdeng.
X nzmu kxetu rdrng nzrlxngiti-kzng, nzamatq-krdr nidr namyatxlz. X nawztr-angidrbzng badr, murde leplz kcng tzokatrlr ni-kzdr mzledrng mz Kraes kcng tzmrlztilr.
Natq Kx Rngidrlvz-ngrbz Pol Mz Timoti
Timoti, alvztrngr x yapwxtipxbz da lcng amrlx mz lrmakxtr.
Murde kzdung ncblo nzalvztr-krdr blepxngr mz nzalvztr-angidrkr Kxetu rgu Jiszs Kxnzmcpx. X trnzlxngitilru Nrpakxmrlz kx leplz nalxngitilr Gct x navz-nqblqlr natqde.

Ncblo kxnzmulr lcng, nzglqpx-lzbqng x trtakitrdeu nidr nzalvztr-krdr. Murde nzaokr drtwrdr trkape. X nzryapwxtr-zvzng mz nzalvztrngr kcng tqbatrpzle nzaki-lzbqngr x nzotablr-zvz-krdr mz kzdung natq. X nzapqtrlr nzdobungr, nzotablrngr, nzrpikitingr, x nztrkakr drtwr. Ncblo lcng trnzesz'ti-zvz-kru drtwrdr, murde nardr lukurnrngr x rblx da angidr nzvztr-krde mz nabzdr. X mz drtwrdr nzvz-nqblq-krdr Gct ngi dalr nzrngisc-krdr da kxkqlu, murde na-abrtzng mz nzngini-krdr bcnyrng.
A' mzli kc na-abrtzlvzku nzvz-nqblq-krgu Gct, rngisc-kzgu da kxkqlu, mz nzrtwz-krgu nivz, nrwx, nzrkrlzngr, nzmnc-zpwxngr, x kzdung kz da kxnzmulr lcng.
Mzli kc tzmika-ngrgu mz nrlc, trpnzngr da kx nzmcmi mzku. X mzli kc nabz-ngrgu trpnzngr da kx natwzku.
Mz nzmu-krde lcde, nzmu kx tqrnginagu dakxnzng x tqrngiscgu lrpz, x tqrnginyzgu ma, drtwrgu naesapx mz da lcng.

A' krkcng nasuti drtwrdr nzngini-krdr bcnyr, ani txpwz nztao-krdr mz da kx vz-rbr, mz nzatatr-krmlr trau. X nqmq nr nabzdr lc, alukurnr-ngrde nidr mz nzesabrti-lzbq-krdr. X nzmu navz zvz mz nzalengr da lcdeng, sa naodati-alopengr nidr mz nzayrplapxngr.
Murde nzmrlz-krbz trau mz leplz ngi nou da kxtrka x alwx kxkqlu. X kzdung leplz, mz nzsutikr drtwrdr trau, nzesablqtipelr nzrlxngitingr angidr, x batrpzle nztalvzokr nabzdr x nzyrpz'kr drtwrdr.
Timoti, nim ncblo ne Gct. Kapx-lzbqm mz da kxtrka lcng amrlx. X lolvz-amqngipwz da kxmrlz lcde seng, nztubqngr, nqmq kr Gct, nzrlxngitingr, nivz, nztu-amqngingr, x nzaodungr.
Mnc-aepztrpz mz Gct x tu amqngi mz nzrlxngiti-krgu. Murde kqlepele nim mz nzmnc-alo-krmu ncdr x rlrpx-lzbqpebzme bade mz mz lrmakxtr.
X mzli ka, kabo bam natq mz mz Gct kc tqngi nou nzlungr, x Mevalu Jiszs kc tqrpipxbz da angidr mzli kc tqtutr-ngrbzle mz mz Pcntizs Paelzt.
Yrlq angidr natq Gct mz nzmncngr kxlqngi x tubq, nakrlzbzle mzli kc nayzlu-ngrm Kxetu rgu Jiszs Kxnzmcpx.
Murde mz mzli kc tqyrlq, Gct sa na-aelwapx-ngrmle da lcng.

content.text: Mz nzngini-krde King r king amrlx,
X nide txpwz nou nzlungr kxboi.

content: Kxnzrlxngiting Kcng Tzngi Bcnyr Ngrdr

Rkabz natq mz kxnzrlxngiting kcng tzngi bcnyr ngrdr dalr nrlc ka. Pibz badr bzkq nzglqpx-lzbqng mz nzrngisc-krdr. X bzkq nzabrtrpzlr drtwrdr mz trau, murde trau ngi da kx namrbr. A' na-abrtrpzlr drtwrdr mz Gct, kc tqrkam bagu da amrlx kcng tqabrtz-ngrgu.
X na-avz-angidrlr trau scdr, murde nzkqlukr nzale-krdr da kxmrlz na-apule nzrngisc-krdr trau kxkqlu. X navqti drtqdr nzrka-nrbalq-krbzlr da mz leplz kx trnzrngiscung.
Murde mz nzale-krdr da lcng, nzaprclr da scdrng mz nrlc ka mz nzyc-alo-krdr Heven. X mzli lcpwz, nzprtrng mz da kxmrlzting kcng tzvzpxmqng mz nzlungr kxboi, kxmule-esz' nzmncbeng mz nrlc.
Natq Ngr Nzarlr-lzbqngr

Timoti, aclve angidr da kcng tzaprcbz bam. Yrlqpx-lzbq mz krkcng nzycmne-krdr trokatrleu leplz, murde sc tqapqtrle nzalvztrngr kx vz-rbr. Kzdung leplz nzyapwxtipxlr da lc, apule kx ngi da angidr. A' nzrpwa'-ngrdr nzalvztrngr angidr.
X mz nzlxngiti-krdr da lc, sc tzvzszpxpelr nzalvztrngr angidr. Krka'-ngrne kx zmrlzkxmyalz nayc-zvzbz bamu. Delape. Ninge Pol.
